ValidationRule.description: Requires Type to be populated leaving Stage 1, and to remain populated through every later stage and once Closed.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND( NOT($Permission.Bypass_Opportunity_Validation),
OR( RecordType.DeveloperName = "Standard_Opportunity", RecordType.DeveloperName = "Framework_Parent_Opportunity" ),
OR( AND( ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(StageName), "Qualification"), ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Solutioning") ), AND( ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(StageName), "Solutioning"), ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Negotiation") ), AND( ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(StageName), "Negotiation"), ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Booking Verification") ), AND( ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(StageName), "Booking Verification"), ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Booked") ), AND( ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(StageName), "Booked"), ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Setup") ), ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Closed") ),
ISBLANK(TEXT(Type)) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please select an Opportunity Type before proceeding. Need help? Contact your Sales Operations Business Partner.
